name: atlas-auth/atlas-pca
description: Official PHP verifier for Atlas Proof-Carrying Authority (PCActn) — strict-JSON wire format v2, Ed25519/ML-DSA leaf signatures, capability-chain and plan-inclusion checks, with optional PSR-15 / Laravel middleware.

suggest.psr/http-server-middleware: To use the framework-agnostic PSR-15 middleware (Atlas\Pca\PcaMiddleware) in Slim, Mezzio, Laminas, etc.
suggest.psr/http-factory: Required by PcaMiddleware to build its error responses (any PSR-17 factory).
suggest.guzzlehttp/psr7: A PSR-7/PSR-17 implementation PcaMiddleware can auto-discover for its error responses; nyholm/psr7 also works.
